enhancements.name: Alien Cunning
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three **^^Tyranids^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Perfectly Adapted
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Once per turn, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll, one Damage roll, one Advance roll, one Charge roll or one saving throw made for the bearer

enhancements.name: Synaptic Linchpin
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. While a friendly **^^Tyranids^^** unit is within 9" of the bearer, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

enhancements.name: Adaptive Biology
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. At the start of any turn, if the bearer has fewer than its starting number of wounds remaining, until the end of the battle, it has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

enhancements.name: Vanguard Intellect
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model with the Deep Strike ability only. The bearer’s unit can be set up using the Deep Strike ability in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules.

enhancements.name: Trygon Prime
enhancements.description: **^^Trygon^^** model only. The bearer gains the **^^Synapse^^** keyword. Improve the Strength and Weapon Skill characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Synaptic Synergy
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. Once per battle, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress stratagem for 0CP, and can do so even if you have already targeted a different unit with that Stratagem this phase.

enhancements.name: Tremor Senses
enhancements.description: **^^Tyranids^^** model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three friendly **^^Tyranids^^** units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Our Time is Nigh
enhancements.description: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Once per battle, when the bearer's unit declares a charge, the bearer can use the Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, add 2 to Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: A Chink in Their Armour
enhancements.description: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Each time the bearer is set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, until the end of your next Fight phase, ranged weapons equipped in the bearer's unit have the **[LETHAL HITS]** ability.

enhancements.name: Prowling Agitant
enhancements.description: **GENESTEALER CULTS** model only. In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8” of this unit, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6”.

enhancements.name: Assassination Edict
enhancements.description: **^^Genestealer Cults^^** model only. Each time a model in the bearer's unit makes an attack that targets a **^^Character^^** unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Primary Detonator
enhancements.description: Once per battle, when an enemy unit opens a closed Hatchway, if the bearer is on the battlefield, it can use this Enhancement. If it does, roll one D6: on a 3-4, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Master Saboteur
enhancements.description: The first time in the battle that your opponent's army Secures an objective marker while the bearer is on the battlefield, roll one D6: on a 3+, that objective marker is not Secured by your opponent's army.

enhancements.name: Devious Disguises
enhancements.description: **NEOPHYTE HYBRIDS** unit only. This unit has ‑3" **detection range**.

stratagems.name: Command Re-roll
stratagems.description: Re-roll one Hit roll, Wound roll, Damage roll, saving throw, Advance roll, Charge roll, Desperate Escape test, or Hazard test.

stratagems.name: Counter-Offensive
stratagems.description: Interrupt the combat sequence immediately after an enemy unit has fought to fight with one eligible unit from your army.

stratagems.name: Rapid Ingress
stratagems.description: Your unit can arrive from Reserves as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, during your opponent's turn.

stratagems.name: Heroic Intervention
stratagems.description: Declare a counter-charge with one eligible unit after an enemy unit completes a charge move within 6" of that unit.

stratagems.name: Smokescreen
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Tank Shock
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range after completing a Charge move; roll dice equal to your vehicle toughness and inflict mortal wounds on 5+.

stratagems.name: Go to Ground
stratagems.description: Target unit gains the Benefit of Cover and a 6+ invulnerable save until the end of the phase.

stratagems.name: Grenade
stratagems.description: Select one enemy unit within 8" and visible to this unit; roll six D6, each 4+ causes 1 mortal wound.

abilities.name: Paroxysm (Psychic)
abilities.description: At the start of the Fight phase, you can select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to this model and roll one D6: on a 1, this Psyker suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 2+, until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

abilities.name: Alpha Warrior
abilities.description: While this model is leading a unit, weapons equipped by models in that unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

abilities.name: Death Blow
abilities.description: If this model is destroyed by a melee attack, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **^^Gargoyles^^**
- **^^Tyranid Warriors With Melee Bio-Weapons^^**
- **^^Tyranid Warriors With Ranged Bio-Weapons^^**

abilities.name: Fear of the Unseen (Aura)
abilities.description: While an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. In addition, in the Battle-shock step of your opponent’s Command phase, if such an enemy unit is below its Starting Strength, it must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Hunter Organism
abilities.description: This model cannot be your Warlord

abilities.name: Winged Swarm
abilities.description: In your Shooting phase, after this unit has shot, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6". If it does, until the end of the turn, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

datasheets.name: Hyperadapted Raveners

abilities.name: Alpha Invader
abilities.description: Weapons equipped by models in this unit have the **[SUSTAINED HITS 1]** ability.

abilities.name: Hypersensory Array
abilities.description:
Once per battle round, you can target this unit with the **Rapid Ingress/Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:
- That use is -1 CP.
- That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description: This unit can be attached to the following units: **^^Raveners^^**

attachableTo: This unit can be attached to the following units: **^^Raveners^^**

abilities.name: Pheromone Trail
abilities.description: Once per battle round, you can target one model with this ability with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

abilities.name: Terror from the Deep
abilities.description: Each time this unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 12" of this model: on a 2-4, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 5+, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Feeder Tendrils
abilities.description: Each time this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model, you gain 1CP

abilities.name: Neural Disruption
abilities.description: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of this model. That unit must take a Battle-shock test

abilities.name: Psychological Saboteur (Aura)
abilities.description:
While an enemy unit is with 12" of this model, if that unit is Battle-shocked:

- Each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll
- Each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

abilities.name: Parasitic Infection
abilities.description: Each time an **^^Infantry^^** model is destroyed by an attack made with this model’s barbed ovipositor, after this model has finished making its attacks, you can add one new **^^Ripper Swarms^^** unit to your army consisting of D3 models and set it up within 3" of this model. If you do, that **^^Ripper Swarms^^** unit can be set up within Engagement Range of the destroyed model’s unit (but not within Engagement Range of any other enemy units).

abilities.name: It Itches!
abilities.description: At the start of the Fight phase, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

abilities.name: Death From Below
abilities.description: At the end of your opponent’s turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

abilities.name: Subterranean Tunnels
abilities.description: In your Movement phase, when this model is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can use a subterranean tunnel. If it does, this model can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

abilities.name: Aerial Seeding
abilities.description: This model must start the battle in Reserves, but neither it nor any units embarked within it are counted towards any limits placed on the maximum number of Reserves units you can start the battle with. This model can be set up in the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of any mission rules. Any units embarked within this model must immediately disembark after it has been set up on the battlefield, and they must be set up more than 8" away from all enemy models. After this model has been set up on the battlefield, no units can embark within it.

abilities.name: Pouncing Leap
abilities.description:
You can target this unit with the **Heroic Intervention stratagem**, regardless of any other uses of that **stratagem** this phase. If you do:
▪ That use is ‑1 CP.
▪ That use does not prevent any uses of that **stratagem** on other units this phase.

This model can be attached to the following units:

- **^^Tyranid Warriors with Ranged Bio-weapons^^**

abilities.name: Monstrous Barrage
abilities.description: This unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.description:
This model can be attached to the following units:
- **^^Carnifexes^^**
- **^^Tyrant Guard^^**

abilities.name: Unstoppable Monstrosity
abilities.description: At the start of each player's Command phase, this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

abilities.name: Swallow Whole
abilities.description: Each time an attack with this model’s gaping maw targets an **^^Infantry^^**, **^^Mounted^^** or **^^Beasts^^** unit, each successful unmodified Wound roll is a Critical Wound. Each time an **^^Infantry^^**, **^^Mounted^^** or **^^Beasts^^** model is destroyed as a result of an attack made by this model’s gaping maw, this model regains up to D3+2 lost wounds.

abilities.name: Subterranean Hunter
abilities.description: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
